content:Speaker assistant says: Wow, Arizona sunsets are truly spectacular! For capturing great sunset photos from the road, timing is crucial. Use a wide-angle lens to capture the expansive sky, and experiment with including foreground elements like your truck or the road for added interest. Don't forget to shoot in RAW format for better post-processing flexibility. Also, stick around after the sun dips below the horizon – often, the most vibrant colors appear 15-20 minutes later.
